concerns.text: T005 claims entropy_matrix.parquet conforms to entropy.schema.yaml with metadata (n_subjects, n_parcels, scales, r_values, seed), but the active contract entropy_schema.schema.yaml REQUIRES metadata fields includes_noise_variance, resampling_correlation, ks_pvalue (tied to a nonexistent FR-009). No task computes noise variance, 2mm-vs-4mm resampling correlation, or a KS test, so T005's output cannot conform as specified — the task is unexecutable against its own stated verification. Either the contract must be amended or T005 must drop the conformance claim.

T007 outputs per-parcel beta/SE/t/p to model_coefficients.csv 'conforming to stat_results.schema.yaml fields', but statistical_result_schema.schema.yaml additionally requires per-row vif and partial_corr_entropy_dsrt (noise-variance-controlled partial correlation). T007 computes VIF once for covariates, not per parcel, and no task computes partial correlations. The stated conformance verification cannot pass.

T003 says outputs conform to subject_qc_schema.schema.yaml, but the schema requires per-subject selected (boolean) and reason fields; T003's description never states these are populated (and 'adaptively chosen cohort' is undefined anywhere). An implementer cannot deterministically decide what `selected` means. Specify the population rule or amend the contract.

Spec US-3/SC-003 and data-model.md name a PDF report (reports/link_entropy_risk.pdf) as a deliverable, but no task produces a PDF — T012 makes figures, T013/T014 markdown. If PDF generation is a paper-stage handoff, T014's handoff doc must explicitly name it; currently the deliverable has no producing task and no declared handoff, so it is unreachable.

FR-008/SC-004 require sweeping 'scale parameter m over a set of discrete magnitudes', but T011 sweeps the scale-averaging set τ with embedding dimension m fixed at 2. T011 is internally executable, but it does not implement the inherited requirement as written; the spec/tasks disagree on the swept parameter, so verification against FR-008 is ambiguous. Resolve the conflation (spec likely means coarse-graining scales) before execution.

Constitution VI mandates a robustness re-analysis restricted to low-motion participants (FD < 0.2 mm), but FR-002/T003 already exclude all FD ≥ 0.2 mm subjects, making the mandated subset identical to the primary cohort — the constitutional check is vacuous and no task performs any distinct motion-robustness analysis (e.g., a stricter FD < 0.1 mm re-run). Root cause is a spec-level conflict; adding tasks cannot fix it without a spec decision on the robustness threshold.

Tasks write results to data/results/, figures/, reports/results_summary.md, while data-model.md specifies results/ and reports/link_entropy_risk.pdf. Path vocabulary differs across artifacts; an implementer following the data model will produce contract-validation failures. Align the data model's paths with the task list (or vice versa).

T002 says 'drop or compact per-subject raw files after QC if needed — state the retention rule' but does not fix the rule now; the implementer must invent it. Minor: pre-specify the default retention rule (e.g., delete raw timeseries parquet after entropy computation, keep checksums) so the task is deterministic.
